description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans clustering membership table implementation using Apache Cassandra as the backend store. It tests operations such as reading, inserting, updating, deleting membership entries, and verifying TTL behavior and gateway list provisioning.

classes.name: CassandraClusteringTableTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the functionality of Cassandra-backed Orleans membership table operations, including CRUD, TTL, and gateway list management.

methods.name: MembershipTable_GetGateways
methods.description: Tests retrieval of gateway URIs from the membership table, ensuring only active members with non-zero gateway ports are included.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadAll_EmptyTable
methods.description: Verifies that reading from an empty membership table returns correct empty data and version info.

methods.name: MembershipTable_InsertRow
methods.description: Tests inserting a membership entry into the table and verifies the version increments accordingly.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadRow_Insert_Read
methods.description: Tests inserting a membership entry, then reading it back, including duplicate insert attempts and version validation.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ReadAll_Insert_ReadAll
methods.description: Verifies that after inserting a membership entry, reading all entries reflects the change with correct versioning.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateRow
methods.description: Tests updating membership entries with correct and incorrect ETags and versions, ensuring concurrency control.

methods.name: MembershipTable_ManyMembershipTables
methods.description: Creates multiple membership table instances concurrently to test scalability and isolation.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateRowInParallel
methods.description: Performs parallel updates to the same membership entry to test concurrency handling.

methods.name: MembershipTable_UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Tests updating the IAmAlive timestamp, TTL behavior, and automatic expiration of membership data in Cassandra.

methods.name: MembershipTable_CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries of silos that are no longer active or have been marked as dead, verifying cleanup logic.

methods.name: CreateMembershipEntryForTest
methods.description: Utility to generate a standard membership entry for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetUtcNowWithSecondsResolution
methods.description: Returns current UTC time truncated to seconds for consistent timestamping.

methods.name: CreateSiloAddressForTest
methods.description: Creates a test SiloAddress with a unique ID and fixed port.

methods.name: CreateNewMembershipTableAsync
methods.description: Initializes a new Cassandra-backed membership table and gateway provider with optional TTL configuration.

methods.name: CreateSession
methods.description: Creates and returns a Cassandra session, starting the container if necessary.

methods.name: A_Test
methods.description: A comprehensive test that exercises multiple membership table operations, including insertions, updates, deletions, and gateway retrieval, with detailed logging.
